title: Daily Signal Brief 015 — Great American AI Act missed-signal recovery; SHRM buyer-awareness gap; AI-recruiter-glitch cultural wave
summary: Quiet weekend window, three elevated signals. (1) L3 missed-signal recovery: the Great American AI Act of 2026 (Obernolte/Trahan bipartisan 269-page discussion draft, released 2026-06-04) preempts state AI development law for three years but explicitly preserves state employment-AI deployment laws — Colorado SB 26-189 ADMT, NYC AEDT, Illinois AIVII, Connecticut, California all intact per the draft text. Stratum's jurisdiction-strict posture now has federal-text backing, not just FCC-docket inference. Eglin missed this for eleven days; federal-AI-bill watch is added to the daily list. (2) L2: SHRM 'State of AI in HR 2026' quantifies a 67% buyer-awareness gap (HR leaders cite 'lack of awareness of AI capabilities' as the biggest blocker to adoption, larger than affordability or legal risk) and a 57% regulated-state-law-awareness gap — Stratum's published methodology + open eval set is now measurably-matching-the-market-condition buyer-education infrastructure. (3) L2: AI-recruiter-glitch narrative crosses to mainstream press — Apriora-via-StretchLab 'Vertical bar Pilates' 3.2M TikTok views, Paradox-via-Whole-Foods accidental hire-then-unhire, NBC News and 404 Media packaging both as a category story. Greenhouse's 'strengthen, not shortcut' and Stratum's structured-hiring positioning get cultural reinforcement from the buyer-press direction. Recommended actions: add federal-text-confirmed-runway frame to Friday's Compass + Forge audit-trail brief; add buyer-education-gap frame to same; Helm internal one-pager on federal AI preemption; Echo press-prep line on Apriora/Paradox; new daily watch on federal-AI-bill markup and agentic-hiring backlash review velocity.
